data.name: Subhiksha
data.long_meaning: The name Subhiksha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'subhika', which means prosperity, fortune, and wealth. In Hindu mythology, Subhiksha is considered a form of the goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name is believed to bring good fortune and abundance to the bearer.

vedic_reference.note: Subhiksha is a modern Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word भिक्षा (bhiksha) meaning 'fortune' or 'prosperity'. It is composed of the prefix सु-su (good) and the root भिक्ष-bhiksha. In Hindu mythology, Bhiksha is also the name of a demon king and a goddess.

data.cultural_impact: The name Subhiksha reflects the cultural value of prosperity and wealth in Hindu society. It is a name that is often given to a child to bless them with good fortune and abundance throughout their life. It is also a name that is respected and admired within the Hindu community, as it signifies the hope and aspiration for a bountiful and successful life.
data.spiritual_significance: Subhiksha is a name that holds great spiritual significance, as it is associated with the goddess Lakshmi. Lakshmi is one of the primary deities in Hinduism, and her blessings are believed to bring prosperity, wealth, and good fortune. The name Subhiksha serves as a constant reminder of Lakshmi's presence and blessings, offering a sense of protection and security in times of need. It also encourages one to cultivate positive virtues such as contentment, generosity, and gratitude, which are essential aspects of Lakshmi's character.

historical_references.reference: Subhiksha was a queen of the Satavahana dynasty, reigning from around 25-30 AD during the western Satavahana period.
Another Subhiksha, a queen of the Vakataka dynasty, is mentioned in the 5th century Indian epic poem, 'Mahabharata', as the mother of the great king Harisena.
